review.reviewer: Codex implementation owner; self-review, not independent approval
review.decision: Repair absent-message-time current chain matching and bound read/retry lifecycle
review.notes: Read-only production observation returns current HQ facts/chain with 200; corresponding transcript source turn has session_id and codex but no time. Existing primary request intentionally refuses historical scope without time, while chain compares returned agent to undefined primary profile. Use only recorded source agent fallback, exact matching SID, existing server/home scope; do not normalize custom agent IDs or substitute current facts. Missing identity is unrecorded and not retryable. Preserve old historical/changed-binding/sender tests without edits. Use existing createReadTask per effect for whole-read deadline and cancellation; no new polling or timeout proof of success. Main merged theme/receipt source untouched except profile control. This seal is local design review only; exact candidate needs independent semantic gate before merge.

cases.description: Message process reads use explicit source identity even without historical time; all agent keys, phone/tablet and languages share the implementation
cases.setup: Real ParticipantProfileModal and ProfileExecutionChain over isolated deferred GtmuxClient; HQ turn with codex/session/record ID and absent time, current radar pane without SID; additional arbitrary custom agent key. Existing historical-source tests retained unmodified. Fake clocks and client/target switches.
cases.action: Open missing-time message avatar, expand current processes, retry transport failure, wait through deadline and settle a superseded response; vary returned session/agent/historical flag, missing source agent, stitched current SID and source sender. Run same missing-time assertion against original M production bytes first and preserve actual red.
cases.expected: No historical fact request without a message timestamp and no false assertion that metadata was read and empty. Current process read is on demand and must match exact source SID and explicit source agent (historical profile agent when actually available, otherwise recorded turn.agent); unknown source identity cannot borrow radar agent or cause futile retry. Current model/tier never fills message facts. Correct same-source chain displays/copies; wrong or rotated source cannot display/copy and has actionable explanation. Retry visibly enters loading, requests once, times out in 15s including uncooperative body/transport, ignores late answers and can recover. UI uses 44pt accessible accent button, static spinner/status; no service, binding, auth or send writes.
